name: 奶油盖黑身裸感气垫款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代奶油盖黑壳与气垫芯质地。
用同脸裸肤与上妆后的双栏对照，一秒展示匀净裸感妆效。
以深肤色同型对照证明色号谱系覆盖到浓郁肤色，扩大代入人群。
用粉扑压上纹理调盘面的微距讲清薄涂匀肤的上妆机制。
用冷调中性暖调三排的空白色阶矩阵帮买家按肤色带找自己的色号。
用满铺开盖色盘阵与一只斜倚主盖的阵型交代多规格可选，引导按量挑档。
收口促单，用三枚勾选利益章与整组产品阵给出直接下单理由。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm white #FBF8F4 sweep for packshots and mechanism screens, soft pearl grey #EFEEEC field for the skin comparison diptych frames, cream grid board for the shade wall, no dark stages, no pastel candy fields
style.direction: clean k-beauty cushion foundation commerce, cream shell on charcoal with marigold framing
style.iconSystem: one-line check discs in marigold rings and blank pill tags on the shade grid, no SPF badges, no gift icons, no award laurels
style.lightingSystem: clean high-key beauty light near 6000K, broad soft key with a fine catchline on the glossy cream lid, even shadowless skin rendering that keeps real texture, one controlled sheen on each foundation swipe, never heavy glow filters
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean k-beauty cushion foundation ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream lid #F2E7DC, charcoal shell #14120F, marigold accent frame #F5A623 and warm foundation swipe #D9B79A on a warm white #FBF8F4 base; clean high-key beauty light near 6000K with a fine catchline on the glossy lid and even shadowless skin that keeps real texture; warm white sweep, pearl grey skin field and cream grid board only, no dark stages, no pastel candy fields; one calm geometric sans in charcoal with at most one marigold accent, every headline, caption band and shade code kept as an empty placeholder; marigold check discs and blank pill tags only, no SPF badges or gift icons; plain unmarked cream lid and charcoal puff ribbon; no color palette changes, no readable codes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable shade codes or SPF marks
no redrawn lid artwork or wordmarks
style.presentationRules: the compact always shows the cream lid and charcoal base with a plain unmarked face, the puff stays solid charcoal with a blank ribbon, skin tones are cast as generic models without identity, every swatch stroke keeps real pigment texture
style.surfaceSystem: glossy warm white sweep, matte charcoal compact shell, cream lid with a single hairline logo-free face, soft skin texture as the canvas, no marble, no floral props
style.typography: one calm geometric sans in charcoal #14120F with at most one marigold #F5A623 accent frame, every headline, caption band and code slot kept as an empty placeholder
